open_questions: Claim type 'other': Infineum performance tables list 'Performance Level' per grade and mass % without approval/meets wording beyond the description.
DL2-10218.pdf (TDS, Version 10 May 2015 (5.0)) is image-only; read visually. Not listed in the old Product_JSON; added per decision (b).
TDS p.2 prints 'Min Load/Unload Temp: 80 °C' above 'Max Load/Unload Temp: 65 °C' (min > max); copied as printed. SDS p.7 gives loading/unloading 55 °C - 65 °C.
Product use (SDS DL2-15274.pdf p.1): 'Additive for heavy duty diesel engine lubricating oil'. VM not named.

Permitted base oils (2026-10 audit): previously recorded as reported [Group I, Group II, Group III] with no source, from an industry rule of thumb based on the highest API claim (API CI-4), not from any supplier document; the field is now missing. Confirm permitted API groups with Infineum.
